summary.intent: Stop two concurrent connection attempts on one subchannel by keeping ac.mu held from connect()'s Idle check (and updateAddrs' restart) through the transition to Connecting.

tasks.premise: For one addrConn, connect() cannot start two connection attempts concurrently: the Idle check and the transition to Connecting share one ac.mu critical section.
Every caller of resetTransportAndUnlock holds ac.mu at the call and the function releases it exactly once on every path before blocking.
The lock hand-off in updateAddrs cannot deadlock with the deferred GracefulClose/onClose, since the spawned goroutine releases ac.mu without waiting on the updateAddrs goroutine.
